# Tasteslikegood.org (VeganGenius Chef)

> A free vegan recipe generator and cookbook. Type what you are craving and get a complete vegan recipe with an AI-generated food photo. No ads, no paywall.

Recipes and their photos are generated with Google Gemini. Published recipes are public pages with schema.org Recipe structured data. Generating a recipe and saving cookbooks happen in the web app and are not available as an API.

## Recipes

- [Browse all published recipes](https://www.tasteslikegood.org/browse): server-rendered index of every public recipe
- [Sitemap](https://www.tasteslikegood.org/sitemap.xml): every public recipe URL, at `/r/<slug>`
- [Newest recipes (JSON)](https://www.tasteslikegood.org/api/public/newest-recipes): name, slug and first publication time of the most recent recipes; a recipe's page is `https://www.tasteslikegood.org/r/<slug>`
